import html from typing import List # Example template – replace with the actual format in your project. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

Posted by {author}

{body}
{tags}
""" def generate_post_html(author: str, title: str, body: str, post_tags: List[str]) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- author : str The name of the post author. title : str The title of the post. body : str The main content of the post. post_tags : list[str] A list of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str The sanitized HTML string ready to be embedded in a page. Notes ----- All user‑supplied input is escaped using `html.escape` to prevent Cross‑Site Scripting (CWE‑79). No additional sanitization is performed beyond escaping, so content that is intended to be HTML (e.g. rich text) should be handled separately by the caller. """ # Escape all user‑controllable input safe_author = html.escape(author, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=False) # Convert tags into escaped elements safe_tags = [] for tag in post_tags: # Ensure the tag itself is escaped; no quotes needed inside safe_tag = html.escape(tag, quote=False) safe_tags.append(f'{safe_tag}') tags_html = " ".join(safe_tags) # Format the final HTML return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( title=safe_title, author=safe_author, body=safe_body, tags=tags_html )
